title: Sunstroke
author: Dark Sun Engine
description: A new 2nd-level spell for clerics, druids and rangers of fire, after Athas's killing sun: Sunstroke. One creature that fails a save against spells is overcome by heat for a round per level of the caster: -2 to hit, its armour class 2 worse, and the Strength spells give (Strength, Enhanced Strength, Adrenalin Control, a lent Strength) does it no good. Those protected from fire (Resist Fire, Protection from Fire), the undead and the elementals and other beings from beyond Athas are untouched. It uses Focus Heat's icon and Dehydrate's look. Off: the game has only the original's spells.
